integrity_policy.fabrication_prohibition: Strictly adhered to. Synthetic benchmarks are explicitly tagged as NUMERICAL_SIMULATION.

acme_cfi_laminar_coflow.facility: ISS Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) Destiny Module / GRC 5.18s Zero-G Facility
primary_investigators: Prof. Peter B. Sunderland (University of Maryland)
primary_citations: Urban, D. L. et al., AIAA 2018-0145
Sunderland, P. B. et al., Combustion and Flame 2020
Stocker, D. P. et al., NASA/TM-2020-220451

sensor_tolerances.temperature_K: +/- 25 K (B-type thermocouple with radiative and convective boundary corrections)

experimental_limitations: G-jitter aboard the ISS is typically 10^-6 to 10^-4 g, introducing minute low-frequency vibrations.
Thermocouple soot deposition can affect emissivity at high equivalence ratios.

flex_droplet_combustion.facility: ISS Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
primary_investigators: Prof. Forman A. Williams (UC San Diego)
primary_citations: Williams, F. A., Dryer, F. L., Nayagam, V. (2012). Combust. Flame 159(12):3583-3591
Dryer, F. L. et al. (2014). Proc. Combust. Inst. 35:1639-1646
experimental_limitations: Tethered droplets experience minimal heat conduction through the supporting SiC fiber (~14 um diameter).
Cool flames emit minimal visible radiation; detection relies heavily on droplet regression rate and radiometer.

grc_candle_flame_comparison.facility: NASA Glenn Research Center 2.2-Second Drop Tower & Mir/Shuttle Spaceflight
primary_citations: Dietrich, D. L., Ross, H. D., et al. (1996). NASA TM-107386
Ross, H. D. (2001). Microgravity Combustion: Fire in Free Fall, Academic Press
experimental_limitations: 2.2 second drop time allows observation of initial spherical relaxation, but long-term steady state requires orbital testing.

sofball_flame_balls.facility: Space Shuttle STS-83, STS-94, STS-107 / CIR
sofball_flame_balls.experiment_name: SOFBALL (Structure of Flame Balls at Low Lewis-number)
primary_investigators: Prof. Paul D. Ronney (University of Southern California)
primary_citations: Ronney, P. D. et al. (1998). Science 282:1305-1309
Ronney, P. D. (1998). Proc. Combust. Inst. 27:2485-2506
experimental_limitations: Flammability limits are sensitive to chamber wall radiative feedback over multi-minute burns.

synthetic_cfd_flame_simulations.facility: Computational Reactive Fluid Dynamics (OpenFOAM / reactingFoam / fireFoam)
primary_citations: CFD Benchmark Model reactingFoam GRI-Mech 3.0 / Discrete Ordinates Radiation
experimental_limitations: Simplified chemical kinetics mechanism (e.g. 53 species GRI-Mech 3.0) neglects higher PAH soot inception routes.
Optically thin or DOM radiation approximation does not capture full spectral line-by-line absorption.
